spectators.label: Sumo wrestler
spectators.look: enormous sumo wrestler with an oiled black topknot, round placid face and thick neck; dark navy mawashi belt with hanging cord fringe, a heavy round belly, bare feet, a small folded white towel over one shoulder
spectators.idle: standing wide with both hands resting on his belly
spectators.cheer: one leg lifted out to the side in a ceremonial stomp, arms spread
spectators.shocked: belly wobbling, mouth a perfect round O

spectators.label: Rugby forward
spectators.look: massive rugby forward with a blond buzz cut, cauliflower ears and white tape wrapped around his head; red-and-white hooped rugby jersey, white shorts, muddy red knee socks, cleats, a brown rugby ball under his arm
spectators.idle: ball tucked under one arm, chest puffed out
spectators.cheer: arms spread wide to the sides with the ball in one hand, roaring

spectators.label: Sprinter with gold medal
spectators.look: lean dark-skinned sprinter woman with a high puff ponytail and a gold medal on a ribbon; yellow-and-green racing singlet with a blank white bib, green running shorts, bright orange track spikes
spectators.idle: stretching one arm across her chest
spectators.cheer: both arms raised out in a wide V, medal swinging

spectators.label: Baseball slugger
spectators.look: stocky baseball player with black eye-black stripes under his eyes and a navy cap; white pinstripe uniform with navy trim, brown leather glove on one hand, a wooden bat resting on his shoulder
spectators.idle: punching his fist into the glove
spectators.shocked: cap blown off, bat sliding off his shoulder

spectators.label: Bodybuilder with shaker
spectators.look: bronze-skinned bodybuilder with a slick black ponytail and a bright white smile; neon orange tank top straining over bulging muscles, gray sweatpants, a purple protein shaker bottle
spectators.idle: flexing one bicep while sipping from the shaker
spectators.cheer: double-biceps pose with arms out to the sides
spectators.shocked: shaker squirting, veins popping on his forehead

spectators.label: Volleyball player
spectators.look: energetic volleyball girl with a short black bob held by a white headband; sky-blue team jersey and shorts, black knee pads, white court shoes, a white-blue-yellow volleyball
spectators.idle: spinning the volleyball on one fingertip
spectators.cheer: jumping with the ball held overhead
spectators.shocked: ball bouncing off her head, mouth open

spectators.label: Boxer in satin robe
spectators.look: scrappy young boxer with wild spiky red hair and a bandaged nose; shiny red satin robe hanging open over a white tank top, red boxing trunks, red boxing gloves on both hands
spectators.idle: shadowboxing lightly, bouncing on his toes
spectators.cheer: punching the air with both gloves
spectators.shocked: gloves up in a high guard, eyes wide

spectators.label: Swimmer with towel
spectators.look: tall lanky swimmer with a white swim cap and blue goggles pushed up on it; navy-and-white team track jacket zipped up, navy track pants, blue flip-flops, a white towel around his neck
spectators.idle: drying his face with the towel
spectators.cheer: swinging the towel in circles, arm out to the side
spectators.shocked: goggles snapping down onto his eyes

spectators.label: Veteran marathon runner
spectators.look: wiry elderly marathon runner with bushy white eyebrows and a white sweatband around his head; sweat-soaked red running tank top, short black running shorts, neon green running shoes, a squeeze water bottle
spectators.cheer: squeezing the water bottle so it sprays upward

spectators.label: Soccer goalkeeper
spectators.look: goalkeeper with spiky blond hair; long-sleeved neon green goalkeeper jersey with black elbow pads, black shorts, white socks, oversized white padded goalkeeper gloves
spectators.cheer: gloves spread wide to the sides
spectators.shocked: both gloves clamped on his head

spectators.label: Rhythmic gymnast
spectators.look: petite teen gymnast with dark brown hair in a tight bun wrapped with a pink ribbon; white warm-up jacket with violet trim, violet track pants, white slippers, a long pink rhythmic-gymnastics ribbon on a stick
spectators.idle: twirling the ribbon idly at her side

spectators.label: Masked luchador
spectators.look: muscular masked pro wrestler with a full gold-and-blue face mask decorated with red flame shapes; long red cape, blue wrestling tights, red knee-high boots, a big championship belt with a plain gold plate slung over one shoulder
spectators.idle: arms crossed, cape draped behind him
spectators.cheer: arms flexed out to the sides, cape flaring
spectators.shocked: clutching his mask with both hands
